listing:

    template: gallery.ejs
    contents: gallery.yml
page-layout: full

::: {#gallery .column-page}
:::


```{=html}
<style>

/* Hide the default Quarto title block */
header#title-block-header {
  display: none;
}

#quarto-content main {
  margin-top: 0;
  padding-top: 0;
}

/* Projects section */
.projects-listing {
  margin-block: 2rem 4rem;
}

.projects-heading {
  max-width: 52rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.projects-heading h2 {
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.projects-heading p {
  max-width: 44rem;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* Individual project rows */
.project-feature {
  padding-block: 2.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
}

.project-copy {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
  align-items: start;
  gap: 3rem;
}

.project-details {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-top: 0;
}

/* Project number */
.project-number {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--bs-primary);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
}

/* Project title */
.project-title {
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 2.5vw, 2.25rem);
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

/* Project description */
.project-subtitle {
  max-width: 32rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* Image frame */
.project-visual {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 5 / 4;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--bs-tertiary-bg);
}

.project-visual a {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.project-visual img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  transition: transform 250ms ease;
}

.project-visual a:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.02);
}

/* Alternate image and text placement */
.project-reverse .project-details {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1;
}

.project-reverse .project-visual {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
}

/* Calls to action */
.project-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
}

.project-link,
.project-source {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.project-link {
  color: var(--bs-primary);
}

.project-source {
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
}

.project-link:hover,
.project-source:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}

.project-status {
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Responsive layout */
@media (max-width: 767.98px) {
  .projects-listing {
    margin-block: 1.5rem 3rem;
  }

  .projects-heading {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  .projects-heading h2 {
    font-size: 2rem;
  }

  .projects-heading p {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .project-feature {
    padding-block: 2rem;
  }

  .project-copy,
  .project-reverse {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }

  .project-details,
  .project-reverse .project-details {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .project-visual,
  .project-reverse .project-visual {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 2;
    aspect-ratio: 5 / 4;
  }

  .project-title {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
  }
}

/* Respect reduced-motion preferences */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .project-visual img {
    transition: none;
  }
}
</style>
```
